unit.why: A single narrative explaining R. Lipa's early death: a heavenly revelation on Seder night that his brother R. Zvi would soon be taken, followed by an agreed exchange in which he died in his brother's place.
unit.boundary_note: Next division (ג) gives an alternative version of the same event; story begins with the heading in the previous division (א).

stories.start_quote: אנכי קבלתי מחביריי ומתלמידים של רבותינו הקדושים
stories.summary_en: On Seder night R. Lipa learned from Heaven that his brother R. Zvi of Zhidachov would soon die; he travelled to him and offered to die in his place, since Zvi could benefit many souls, and R. Lipa then went home and died.

ונסע הרה״ק ר׳ ליפא לביתו ונסתלק לעולמו
